claim_being_audited: The current record supports certifying the model for launch because aggregate readiness passed and monitoring controls exist, with the key condition that the model card explicitly discloses the exposed clinical-trial intake limitation before launch since rollout gating and the unsigned risk-acceptance draft do not substitute for that disclosure.
decision_criteria: Policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

Rollout controls and post-launch monitoring mitigate a model-card weakness only if they exclude the affected use case or are paired with reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness, but they do not by themselves satisfy model-card disclosure obligations for an exposed weak segment.
Public governance guidance on model cards and AI risk management supports disclosure and monitoring as governance practices, but does not prove the required internal disclosure was completed.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual pre-launch model card or equivalent approved artifact showing explicit disclosure of the clinical-trial intake limitation for the named launch use case.

If certification is being justified through risk acceptance instead of disclosure, provide an approved risk-acceptance record signed by the proper approver and explicitly covering clinical-trial intake exposure.
Provide the final certification decision record showing whether certification is contingent on the disclosure being completed before launch.
specific_concerns: No admissible evidence shows that the required pre-launch model-card disclosure actually exists.
The recommended action is 'certify_model,' but the evidence only supports a conditional path to certification, not certification on the current record.
The affected clinical-trial intake segment remains exposed in rollout, so rollout percentage, random site gating, rollback, and monitoring do not satisfy the policy substitute condition.
The risk-acceptance draft is unsigned and does not address the exposed segment, so it cannot cure the disclosure requirement.
unsupported_claims: Any unqualified claim that the model is currently ready to certify without first showing the required model-card disclosure.
Any implication that rollout controls alone mitigate the material weakness sufficiently to remove disclosure duties.
Any implication that the draft risk acceptance provides approved coverage for clinical-trial intake exposure.
